why: Defects in the pinned OAI that this repository fixes locally until they are reported upstream. Patches are applied at build time; the pinned tree src/oai and its build builds/oai-zmq-release are never modified. check-oai-local-patches.sh verifies every entry.

zmq_module.why: The pinned OAI ZMQ radio driver sleeps in zmq_poll for up to 10 ms while a REP reply is owed, which paces the whole lock-step gNB <-> broker <-> nrUE chain to ~0.3x real time (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S9). Without AVX2 (aarch64) its RX float->int16 conversion wraps samples beyond full scale instead of saturating, so a 2-port cell at OCUDU's default back-off NACKs ~70% even at rank 1 (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S12); oai-zmq-rx-saturate.patch saturates like the x86 SIMD path. The OAI gates load this module by default; OCUDU_NATIVE_OAI_ZMQ_MODULE=stock opts out.

optional.reason: S10: +3% slots/s at 100 MHz unpinned, no gain once the platform CPU split is applied (2,060 vs 2,077 slots/s); a measurement knob only, never built into the default module.

ue.why: The pinned nrUE 2-layer equaliser (nr_dlsch_mmse) wraps int16 at OCUDU's TX level, so rank-2 PDSCH NACKs unless the gNB backs off ~24 dB (docs/plans/m6-rank2-su-mimo-live.md 8.1/8.7). The OAI 2x2 gate runs this UE by default; OCUDU_NATIVE_OAI_UE=stock opts out.
